name: fair-rivals-parts
cmd: set -e; for t in 1995 1985; do for s in 1 2; do for st in sel late; do if [ $st = sel ]; then c=desk_tempho_${t}_s${s}; else c=desk_tempho_${t}_s${s}_late; fi; A=$(ls -d {outroot}/E038/attr-commondir-t${t}-${st}-*/ | head -1)ctrl_s${s}/attribution_cells.npz; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --rich-base --attr $A --tag _parts; done; done; done
summarize: for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1995_s1_late desk_tempho_1985_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1_late desk_tempho_1995_s2 desk_tempho_1995_s2_late desk_tempho_1985_s2 desk_tempho_1985_s2_late; do echo == $c; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --summarize {out}/$c | grep -E 'DROP|-land |-luh_uniform|-luh_pattern|-climate|-luh_mgmt'; done
note: E039m: which swap part of DESK's change (LUH uniform shift vs pattern, land vs climate) carries its gain beyond the trend (placebo and rich base), late and selected
